issues.reason: "classes of 48" states each class's own size, so `(Cardinality sk_classes_1 48)` on the group of classes — "the size of *that* group" — falsely says there are 48 classes.

*Categorical statements* bars a members' property on the group symbol ("a bare `(Member <group> <prop>)` appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself — its size, its name"), and fullness holds of each class, not of the collection.

*Names and casing* takes the kind from the kind word in or beside the name ("the Kestrel River" → `river`), so the licensed atom is `administration`; "agency" fails *Core patterns*' test — no word in the sentence puts it there.

The standing half is the missing possessive: *Possessive / genitive NP* requires `(Possession <possessed> <possessor>)` for a possessive pronoun ("her sister" → `Member` + `Possession`) and none is emitted; the reuse half fails, since resolving the anaphoric definite "its classes" to the salient antecedent is ordinary coreference.

The shared symbol's second mention "its classes" is a definite possessed NP, and *Core patterns* projects a definite referent's typing atom out of every seal alike — the TSA's classes are presupposed to exist whatever he said — so the top-level `GroupOf` is licensed.

Booking reserves rather than creates, destroys, consumes or changes the classes — the *bought / rented* case the role table assigns `Theme` — and "when the test is unclear, default to `Theme`"; the occurrence-altering `Patient` extension is for *cancel / postpone / reschedule*, which change whether or when the class happens.

gaps_confirmed: a size postmodifier distributing over a plural ("classes of 48") — `Cardinality` rides one group, so each member-group's own size has no licensed carrier
mid-sentence quotative parenthetical ("…, he said, and <second clause>") — nothing says how far the reported-speech seal extends over a following coordinated clause
new_gaps: a descriptive modifier on a plural INSIDE a seal — the licensed carrier is a distribution rule, which needs its own `Implication` form and its own STV, and a sealed `(And …)` term can carry neither, so the property is unexpressible there
which mention governs projection when one group symbol is introduced by an indefinite inside a seal and later referred to by a definite possessed NP
repair_summary: Removed the false `(Cardinality sk_classes_1 48)` and recorded the size-postmodifier gap. Removed `(Member sk_classes_1 full)` — the licensed fix is a distribution rule, which cannot be expressed inside a sealed term, so per the registered "seal what is expressible" limitation the modifier is left out rather than mis-slotted. `(Member transportation_security_administration agency)` → `administration`, the kind word inside the name. `(Patient sk_book_1 sk_classes_1)` → `(Theme sk_book_1 sk_classes_1)`. Added `(Possession sk_classes_1 transportation_security_administration)` inside the seal for the possessive "its".
notes: The possessive atom was added on the standing half of issue 3; it is placed inside the seal because the projection rule licenses only typing atoms to leave a seal. The attitude scaffolding, the control-verb handling of "plans to double", and the top-level `GroupOf` projection are unchanged.
